torque_curve.source: User-supplied 2026-10-15 (pasted summary of the 16k spindle's power/torque characteristics). Not yet checked against the Brother spindle output chart.
torque_curve.format: Per duty rating: [rpm, torque N·m] points. Interpolate POWER (T·omega) linearly in rpm between points; that is exact for both constant-torque and constant-power segments (interpolating torque linearly overstates it by up to ~8% in a constant-power segment). 'derived': true means the points were computed from the stated power (T = P/omega) rather than quoted.
torque_curve.quoted: Rated at 5.1 kW (6.8 HP) continuous and 7.4 kW (9.9 HP) for 10-minute/15% ED; peak instantaneous 18.9 kW (25.3 HP). Maximum instantaneous torque 40 N·m from 0 up to base speed (~4,500 RPM). From base speed to 16,000 RPM power remains flat while torque decays inversely with speed (~8.8 N·m at 8,000 RPM, ~5.9 N·m at 12,000 RPM, ~4.4 N·m at 16,000 RPM).

continuous.note: Constant power 5.1 kW above base speed; constant torque below it is assumed (only the momentary curve is stated to be constant-torque).

s3_15pct_10min.note: The 8k/12k/16k torques are given and equal 7.4 kW; the 0-4500 rpm segment is derived and assumed constant-torque.

momentary.note: Given up to base speed only. Above 4500 rpm the momentary curve is not stated.

notes: The 16k torque curve is user-supplied (2026-10-15); confirm against the Brother spindle output chart. Torque for the 27k option is not published on the product page. active_spindle confirmed by the owner (16k non-dual-contact).
